sections.title: The letter pi
paragraphs: The letter (pi) /pi/ is named (pi) /pi/. Its main sound is heard in the word (pane) /ˈpa.ne/, which means bread. This letter makes two sounds.

sections.title: Making the sound
paragraphs: Close both lips together to stop the air. Then open your lips to let the air out. Do not use your voice. Touch your throat to feel that it does not shake. For the long sound, close your lips firmly and hold them closed for a moment before you release the air.

sections.title: Reading the letter
paragraphs: In all positions, this letter makes the sound /p/, that is a short p, as in (aperto) /aˈpɛr.to/. When written as a double consonant between vowels, it makes the sound /pː/, that is a long p, as in (cappa) /ˈkap.pa/.

sections.title: Avoiding mistakes
paragraphs: Do not release a puff of air when you say this letter. In English, the letter p in the word pet has a puff of air. In Italian, keep the air tight behind your lips and release it cleanly. Hold a hand before your mouth to feel almost no breath.
